name: Isabela Oliveira
bio:
Isabela's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood, watching Ayrton Senna dominate the tracks. After graduating with a degree in Marketing from the Universidade de São Paulo, she started her career at a local racing team, quickly proving her ability to create engaging campaigns that resonated with fans and sponsors alike. Her experience spans digital marketing, social media management, and event coordination, making her a versatile asset to any team.

At Team Penske, Isabela is responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies that enhance the team's brand image and drive fan engagement. She's known for her data-driven approach, constantly analyzing market trends and performance metrics to optimize her campaigns. Isabela's distinctive ability lies in blending her creative vision with a deep understanding of the motorsport industry, resulting in innovative and impactful marketing initiatives. 

Isabela's ambition is to build a world-class marketing department that will help Team Penske reach new heights of success. She is a valuable addition to the team and her dedication to excellence helps the organization achieve its goals.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied in a high ponytail
physical.description: Isabela has a petite frame and a warm, engaging smile.

quirks: Always has a yerba mate tea brewing at her desk.
Insists on reviewing every social media post before it goes live.
Uses motorsport analogies in everyday conversations.
